initialExam.title: CTET (Central Teacher Eligibility Test) 2026
initialExam.description: CTET is mandatory for teaching posts in KVS, NVS, and other central government schools. Valid for lifetime. Notification out 11 May 2026.
initialExam.eligibility: Graduation + B.Ed/D.El.Ed for Paper-I (Class 1-5), Graduation + B.Ed for Paper-II (Class 6-8)
initialExam.syllabus: Paper-I (Class 1-5): Child Development & Pedagogy (30Q), Language-I (30Q), Language-II (30Q), Mathematics (30Q), Environmental Studies (30Q). Paper-II (Class 6-8): CDP (30Q), Language-I (30Q), Language-II (30Q), Math/Science or Social Studies (60Q).
initialExam.examPattern: Paper-I: 150 questions, 150 marks, 2.5 hours. Paper-II: 150 questions, 150 marks, 2.5 hours. No negative marking.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Qualify CTET → Apply for teaching posts in KVS/NVS/Central Schools
initialExam.jobRole: Eligibility for PRT (Paper-I) and TGT (Paper-II) in central government schools
initialExam.careerGrowth: PRT → TGT → PGT → Vice Principal → Principal.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit ctet.nic.in 2. Register 3. Fill form 4. Upload documents 5. Pay fee 6. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Medical, Summer/Winter Vacation, Children Education Allowance

ageLimitDetails.relaxation: No upper age limit for the test
